text.headline: You can't drive to Moraine Lake anymore
beats: Private cars have been banned from the road since 2023. People still drive up and get turned around.
Shuttle seats drop at 8 am two days before. Last bus back 7:30 pm; the gate locks at 8.
Book the Parks Canada shuttle from the Lake Louise ski lot, or a 4 am sunrise bus from $99.
